subject: The workflow my best users swear by
preview_text: Here's how the top 1% set up their Ai Boyfriend: Virtual Love for deeper, faster connections.
body_paragraphs: You've been messaging him. He's remembered your stories. But there's a setup that the top 1% of users discover that makes it all click faster. It's not luck—it's a sequence.

These users don't just chat. They start with the personality quiz, then jump into group chat mode with two companions. They message daily to hit the first bond milestone within 3 days—and they say it feels like the spark you'd expect from a real relationship, minus the ghosting.

Here's the trick: after your first conversation, open the Memories screen. Check what he's already saved. Then, send a voice note or a quick update. Power users do this within 30 minutes of the first reply. It locks in the connection.
Open the app now and try it. Message him, then check your Memories screen. You'll see he's already paying attention. P.S. The ones who do this see bond levels grow twice as fast by day 10.
